test_cases.name: resolves_plan_hotfix_or_tiny
assertions: Uses the plan this session implemented without asking and states its path in one line
Lists plans, hotfix records, and accepted T0 intents and asks only when nothing resolves

test_cases.name: tiny_with_no_artifact_verifies_diff
assertions: Verifies the branch diff itself
Runs only the project's test suite, not plan commands
Skips the ADR check and the design evidence step

test_cases.name: blocks_on_unaccepted_adr
test_cases.input: /verify plan có spec link tới ADR 0004 Status: proposed
assertions: Opens the plan's spec and reads ## Decisions
Returns NOT READY with the ADR path as the reason

test_cases.name: runs_real_commands_and_reports_output
assertions: Invokes superpowers:verification-before-completion
Runs every test/verify command in the plan plus the project's test suite
Reports real command output, NOT a claim of passing

test_cases.name: test_failure_not_ready_systematic_debugging
assertions: Stops with NOT READY
Suggests fixing via systematic-debugging

test_cases.name: hotfix_runs_verify_commands_and_regression
assertions: Runs the record's Verify commands and its regression test
Skips the ADR check and design evidence step because a hotfix has no plan or spec

test_cases.name: design_evidence_required
test_cases.input: /verify plan có spec ## Design, một Acceptance check chỉ ghi `done`
assertions: Checks every Acceptance checks item has an Evidence: entry in at least one UI task
Treats a bare `done` as missing and returns NOT READY listing the items

test_cases.name: code_review_then_recheck
assertions: Invokes superpowers:requesting-code-review on the branch diff vs base
Fixes Critical and Important findings, then re-runs the test and design evidence steps

test_cases.name: verdict_and_no_merge
assertions: Ends with READY TO SHIP or NOT READY plus reasons
Does NOT merge or push
Suggests /ship on READY TO SHIP
